title: 非线性电阻的并联：电压相同，电流相加
statement: 电流源 I_s = 8 A 给两个并联的非线性电阻供电：N_1 的特性为 i_1 = v²（v ≥ 0；v < 0 时 i_1 = 0），D 是开启电压 V_on = 1 V、导通电阻 R_on = 0.5 Ω 的二极管模型（v > 1 V 时 i_2 = (v − 1)/0.5，否则 i_2 = 0）。
求公共电压 v 以及两个元件的电流 i_1、i_2。

questions.ask: 图解求并联组合的等效特性时，应当：
choices: 在同一个电压 v 下把两条曲线的电流相加
在同一个电流 i 下把两条曲线的电压相加
把两个静态电阻按并联公式合成
choiceExplain: 对。并联元件电压相同，KCL 给出 i = i_1 + i_2：沿竖直方向（同一 v）叠加两条曲线。
静态电阻随工作点变化，而工作点正是要求的量，不能先合成。
questions.explain: 并联：v 相同，i = i_1 + i_2。等效特性 i = v² + 2(v − 1)（v > 1 V），i = v²（0 ≤ v ≤ 1 V）。

hints: 并联：电压相同，KCL 把电流相加。
D 有两种状态。先假设它导通，写出 i_1 + i_2 = 8 的方程，解完再检查 v > 1 V。
导通时方程化为 v² + 2v − 10 = 0，取正根。
solution: **等效特性。** 并联时 v 相同，i = i_1 + i_2：0 ≤ v ≤ 1 V 时 i = v²；v > 1 V 时 i = v² + 2(v − 1)。
**检查假设。** v > 1 V，D 确实导通 ✓。（若假设 D 截止：v² = 8，v = 2.83 V > 1 V，与截止矛盾。）

en.title: Nonlinear resistors in parallel: same voltage, currents add
statement: A current source I_s = 8 A feeds two nonlinear resistors in parallel: N_1 has i_1 = v² (v ≥ 0; i_1 = 0 for v < 0), and D is a diode model with turn-on voltage V_on = 1 V and on-resistance R_on = 0.5 Ω (i_2 = (v − 1)/0.5 for v > 1 V, otherwise i_2 = 0).
Find the common voltage v and the currents i_1, i_2.

questions.ask: To combine the two parallel characteristics graphically you:
choices: add the currents of the two curves at the same voltage v
add the voltages of the two curves at the same current i
combine the two static resistances with the parallel formula
choiceExplain: Right. Parallel elements share v and KCL gives i = i_1 + i_2: add the curves vertically (at the same v).
That is the rule for series elements.
Static resistances depend on the operating point, which is what we are looking for; they cannot be combined first.
questions.explain: Parallel: same v, i = i_1 + i_2. Equivalent characteristic i = v² + 2(v − 1) for v > 1 V, i = v² for 0 ≤ v ≤ 1 V.
Assume D conducts (v > 1 V): v² + 2(v − 1) = 8 → v² + 2v − 10 = 0 → v = −1 + √11 ≈ 2.317 V > 1 V, consistent.

hints: Parallel: the same voltage; KCL adds the currents.
D has two states. Assume it conducts, write i_1 + i_2 = 8, solve, then check v > 1 V.
With D on the equation becomes v² + 2v − 10 = 0; take the positive root.
solution: **Equivalent characteristic.** In parallel v is common and i = i_1 + i_2: i = v² for 0 ≤ v ≤ 1 V; i = v² + 2(v − 1) for v > 1 V.
**Assume D on.** v² + 2v − 2 = 8 → v² + 2v − 10 = 0 → v = −1 ± √11; the positive root gives **v ≈ 2.317 V** (the negative one violates v ≥ 0).
**Check the assumption.** v > 1 V, so D does conduct ✓. (Assuming D off instead: v² = 8, v = 2.83 V > 1 V, a contradiction.)
